what: A full-screen panel (video·photo) stays attached to the section and over 1.5 screens of scroll shrinks to .65x while its corners round to 24px — starts at section progress .2 and runs .8 with power2.inOut, following the scroll .3s late (scrub .3). The background shows around the panel as it moves on to the next section

options.at: Progress at which shrinking starts (0–1), default .2

from.where: index.html .tw-reel (original home video: top top → +=150%, scrub .3, scale .65·borderRadius 24px .8s power2.inOut @.2)
